rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A multi-provider MCP server architecture that currently implements Google Chat API integration, enabling AI assistants to send messages, search conversations, manage spaces, and retrieve user information through natural language commands. Built with a modular provider system using FastMCP and featuring OAuth 2.0 authentication with automatic token refresh, the server supports multiple search modes including regex pattern matching, exact substring matching, and semantic similarity search for finding relevant messages across chat spaces. The implementation includes comprehensive tooling for message management (send, reply, update, delete), space administration (member management, participant analysis), file attachments, and conversation summarization, making it valuable for automating workplace communication workflows and extracting insights from team discussions.
